title: Create games, shape scenery, recover sign-in

features.title: Create game and Open game
features.description: The universal designer starts with game terminology. Custom games use player pieces and boards, with campaign language reserved for the selected game style.

features.title: Explicit scenery module sizes
features.description: Choose 1×1, 2×2, 2×3 or custom whole-module dimensions. Fit retained scenery locally and apply the OpenLOCK carrier inside the total requested height. Physical print fit still needs review.

features.title: Clone and adjust related pieces
features.description: Keep the brief, approved artwork and selected source model when creating a separate variant. Local sizing and connector fitting do not submit a paid generation job.

features.title: Cancel and retry sign-in
features.description: Cancel a waiting browser sign-in and immediately try again. If a saved ChatGPT connection cannot be read, settings remain accessible and local repair keeps an encrypted backup. API keys are preserved.

features.title: Clear conversation funding
features.description: A damaged ChatGPT connection does not silently switch conversation charges to an API key. Choose API key only explicitly to use that billing route.

features.title: Launcher recovery
features.description: The launcher accepts the editor’s own diagnostic log while continuing to verify signed application files. Future diagnostics are stored outside the client package.
